title: Qman DirectPath canonical Git source-tree manifest
description: Deterministic complete projection of the tracked Git tree used to build a target runner. It removes ambiguity between a commit ID, a dirty working tree and an unexplained sourceTreeSha256 label.

entries.x-qmanCanonicalOrder: ascending UTF-8 path bytes; paths are unique after NFC normalization

x-qmanTreeProjectionRule: Read the exact commit object named by targetRepositoryCommit from the target repository object database, never the working tree or index. repositoryObjectFormat=SHA1 requires exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters for every commit/object ID; SHA256 requires exactly 64. Enumerate every tracked root-tree entry recursively in Git byte order. Every path MUST be valid NFC UTF-8 and repository-relative; otherwise target mapping fails closed. For modes 100644, 100755 and 120000, contentSha256 hashes the exact Git blob bytes and byteLength is their length (a symlink blob is its link-target bytes). For mode 160000, contentSha256 hashes the lowercase ASCII gitlink commit and byteLength is 40 or 64; exactly one same-path submoduleTrees descriptor recursively resolves a complete manifest at that commit. No untracked, ignored, generated-after-checkout or dirty-working-tree file may enter the build.
x-qmanCompletenessRule: entries is exactly the full recursive `git ls-tree` projection of targetRepositoryCommit: no omission, extra path, duplicate normalized path, mode/object mismatch or unresolved gitlink. submoduleTrees is in bijection with mode-160000 entries and recursively obeys the same rules; cycles or path escape fail closed. Build inputs, runner source, predicate evaluators, artifact decoders and build recipes must all resolve to this closure. Runtime-only secrets may be injected as declared non-source inputs but cannot change compiled bytes without changing the pinned tool/build evidence.
x-qmanDigestRule: Set sourceTreeSha256 to null, encode the complete closed object with CANONICAL-JSON-V1, and store SHA-256 of those bytes in sourceTreeSha256. The consuming RunnerManifest separately binds both this internal digest and the raw manifest-file SHA-256.
